intervals.description: Spherical-spline implementation, Qt presentation refinement and validation

summary: Implemented regularized Perrin spherical splines on a fitted full-template 3D sphere, positive log-power mapping, smooth 128x128 Qt rendering, compact toolbar and available-channel circles without text labels or hatching.
results: 22 tests passed: 4 spherical-spline, 5 montage, 8 numerical topography and 5 Qt topography GUI tests.
Spline validation: exact unregularized sensor reconstruction, constant preservation, independent degree-one spherical field, rotational/order invariance and invalid-coordinate handling.
Verified shared source/target sphere origin and exact projection inverse, positive log-power maps, voltage unit scaling, frozen-state controls and marker-only dense cap rendering.
Inspected wide, expanded and small-window offscreen previews. 1450x940 retains 922/461 px main/side widths and no scrolling.
Removed permanent electrode text and hatching, kept circles with channel names on hover; changed Designer checkbox wording to spherical-spline extrapolation.
No new runtime dependencies. Changes remain local, uncommitted and unpushed on codex/portable-environment.
open_items: Native real-source validation on target workstation.
limitations: Initial inspection preceded first logged timestamp.
Full scalp beyond electrode coverage remains estimated; spherical splines may overshoot observed extrema, and color limits include the displayed field.
Band power is spatially interpolated in log space and displayed in original squared units.
Validation used synthetic data and offscreen Qt.
